text:
If your eyes looked only one way, what would they not burn? If not in different directions, sunset or East would freeze.


The crooked leftward glance is criminal; your lights fire wicked, sweet, burning light with deceitful aim.


They see what they do not look at; all who see them are spoils; conquest gives soul rewards and torments.


What law moved the bad jurist, when both eyes are monarchs, to call them viscounts of sight?

translation.title: To a Beautiful Cross-Eyed Lady
